instruction:
One-Storey Community Market Hall Schedule

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an Archicad one-storey community market hall model and save the required outputs to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt as a tab-delimited zone schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey and exactly 13 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 1 IfcSlab entity and at least 1 IfcRoof entity.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: AISLE, HALL, STALL-1, STALL-2, STALL-3, STALL-4, STALL-5, STALL-6, STALL-7, STALL-8, COLD-STORE, DRY-STORE, and WC.
7. Each listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. The IFC area quantities for the spaces are AISLE 54.0 m2, HALL 12.0 m2, STALL-1 7.5 m2, STALL-2 7.5 m2, STALL-3 7.5 m2, STALL-4 7.5 m2, STALL-5 7.5 m2, STALL-6 7.5 m2, STALL-7 7.5 m2, STALL-8 7.5 m2, COLD-STORE 9.0 m2, DRY-STORE 9.0 m2, and WC 5.0 m2, each with tolerance +/-0.10 m2.
9. The combined area of STALL-1 through STALL-8 is between 59.0 m2 and 61.0 m2, and the sum of all listed space areas is between 148.0 m2 and 150.0 m2.
10. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: ZoneName, Area, Storey.
11. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt has exactly 13 data rows in the same zone order as the IFC area list, with Storey value GROUND for every row and the same names and areas listed in the IFC pass conditions.
12. Each schedule Area value matches the corresponding IFC space area with tolerance +/-0.10 m2.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
